records.title: Raw upstream signal carrier rejects extra authority and detaches caller-owned payload containers
adjudication_notes: The pre-repair new Tier A family failed because RawUpstreamSignalInput retained caller-owned nested payload containers after model construction.
The bounded source repair adds a payload field validator that deep-copies caller input before raw-signal scope admission.
The new retained Tier A family also proves extra authority fields are rejected at the raw signal carrier boundary.

Does not authorise cognition, broker, capital, risk-policy, dependency, or runtime trading behaviour.
